titulo: The first computer bug was a REAL bug 🦋
descripcion: In 1947, engineers found a moth inside the Harvard Mark II and taped it into the logbook. It's still at the Smithsonian.

escenas.texto: In nineteen forty seven, a computer at Harvard kept making errors. The culprit? A moth.
Engineers found it stuck in relay number seventy, panel F, of the Mark Two computer.
So they did the obvious thing. They taped it into the logbook.
Next to it, someone wrote: first actual case of bug being found.
Here's the twist. Engineers already called glitches bugs. The joke was the word actual.
That logbook page, moth still taped on, is kept at the Smithsonian today.
Every bug has a history. Follow for more tech secrets.
